title: Cymbopogon citratus tea for medicinal use
intro: Cymbopogon citratus tea is a herbal infusion made from the leaves of the lemongrass plant, which is native to tropical regions. It is commonly used in herbalism for its calming and digestive properties. This tea is often consumed to help alleviate stress, anxiety, and digestive discomfort. Its mild citrus flavor makes it a popular choice for both medicinal and culinary use. In traditional medicine, it is also believed to support respiratory health and promote relaxation.
